results.title: Request filtering of private addresses (with and without the JWT bypass), download cap, cache retention
evidence: private addresses disallowed, default directIfIn.jwtToken true: document opened true, fetched true; callbacks reaching the private-address consumer 2; conversion succeeded

control, private addresses disallowed and directIfIn.jwtToken false (override {"externalRequest":{"directIfIn":{"jwtToken":false}}}): document opened false, fetched false; callbacks reaching the private-address consumer 0; conversion refused {"http":200,"error":-4}

so the private-address filter is bypassed for URLs inside JWT-signed configs and commands by directIfIn.jwtToken; turning it off makes the filter apply (and would break any intended internal URL, e.g. the legacy http://api:3020 flows, unless those move to allowed hosts)

defaults: "request-filtering-agent": { "allowPrivateIPAddress": false, "allowMetaIPAddress": false }, "directIfIn": { "allowList": [], "jwtToken": true }, "action": { "maxDownloadBytes": 104857600, "files": 86400, "filesCron": "00 00 */1 * * *",
